value.syntax: # [derive (Subcommand)] enum Command { # [doc = " Project TOML inputs into deterministic JSON datasets."] Generate { # [arg (value_enum)] mode : Mode , # [command (flatten)] files : CheckOutputArgs , } , # [doc = " Compare or refresh rendered documents."] Render { # [arg (value_enum)] mode : Mode , # [command (flatten)] files : CheckOutputArgs , } , # [doc = " List templates, datasets and rendered documents."] Census , # [doc = " Check one closed public installation evidence document."] InstallationCheck { # [command (subcommand)] check : InstallationCheck , } , }
